title: Buddy
subtitle: Connect an M5StickC Plus hardware device as a physical tool approval channel.

desktopOnly.title: Desktop only
desktopOnly.description: Buddy is a local hardware peripheral feature available in the BitFun desktop app.

general.title: General
general.description: Enable the Buddy feature and choose how the bridge process is managed.

enable.label: Enable Buddy
enable.description: Route tool confirmation requests to your M5StickC Plus device.

mode.label: Bridge Mode
mode.description: Managed: BitFun starts and monitors the bridge process. External: you run it yourself.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: HTTP connection between BitFun and the agent-buddy-bridge.

bridgeUrl.label: Bridge URL
bridgeUrl.description: URL of the agent-buddy-bridge HTTP server.

callbackPort.label: Callback Port
callbackPort.description: Port for BitFun's callback server that receives approval results.

bindAddress.label: Bind Address
bindAddress.description: Bind address for the callback server. Use 127.0.0.1 for local-only access.

paths.title: Bridge Paths
paths.description: Paths used when launching the bridge process in managed mode.

bridgePath.label: Bridge Path
bridgePath.description: Path to the agent-buddy-bridge project directory.

pythonPath.label: Python Path
pythonPath.description: Python executable with bleak/CoreBluetooth. Auto-detected on macOS.

status.title: Status
status.description: Current connection state of the Buddy bridge and device.

bridge.label: Bridge
bridge.description: Health of the bridge process and BLE device connection.

test.label: Test Connection
test.description: Send a test state push to the bridge and verify reachability.

alert.disabled: Buddy is disabled. Enable it to route tool approvals to your M5StickC device.

prerequisites.title: Prerequisites Check
prerequisites.unsupported: Buddy currently only supports macOS. This feature requires CoreBluetooth for BLE and is not available on this host OS.

bridge.title: Bridge Start
bridge.description: BitFun will start the agent-buddy-bridge process in managed mode.
bridge.managed: The bridge will be spawned automatically with --platforms bitfun.

device.title: Device Discovery
device.description: Searching for M5StickC Plus devices broadcasting as Claude-XXXX.
device.notFound: No M5StickC found. Ensure it is powered on and not connected to another host.

test.title: Test Approval
test.description: A test state will be pushed to the device. Press the M5StickC button to verify the round-trip.
test.success: Test approval received! Buddy is ready.
test.failed: Test approval failed. Check the bridge logs.
